title: Tagine with Tofu and Algerian Spices
description: A French-inspired vegetarian tagine made with crispy tofu, spices, and fresh herbs. Perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
In a small bowl, mix together the tagine spice mix and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Sprinkle the spice mix over the tofu and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the parsley and serve hot.
Garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
Serve with couscous or over rice.
